6112f80fa1.text: This page has a voice, and the voice was recorded before you arrived. Nothing is generated while you listen, and nothing you do here is sent to a speech service.

6567ae20be.text: Each paragraph was turned into a small sound file on the author's own computer. The file is named after a fingerprint of the paragraph's text, so the page can find it without keeping a list.

2502044aa5.text: If a paragraph is edited, its fingerprint changes and the old file no longer matches. The paragraph stays silent until it is recorded again, which takes one command.

20712d318c.text: Some things are written one way and said another. Here the recorder spells out CSS, reads 20 °C as a temperature, and knows that 3 × 4 = 12.

31488ef396.text: The voice is computer-generated. It comes from Kokoro, an open text-to-speech model, and you can switch it off with the button at the top of the page.
